name: Agents (Multi-harness Agentic Plugin Marketplace)
description: Multi-harness agentic plugin marketplace for AI coding tools with 94 plugins, 203 domain expert agents, 175 modular skills, and 109 commands. Supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini CLI from a single Markdown source.

name: ZCF (Zero-Config Code Flow)
description: Zero-config, one-click setup for Claude Code & Codex with bilingual support, intelligent agent system and personalized AI assistant. Supports 10+ popular AI coding tools with TypeScript-based workflow automation.

name: Nanocoder
description: An open-source terminal-based AI coding assistant built by a community collective. Features multi-provider support (Ollama, OpenRouter, Anthropic, Google), local-first architecture with privacy focus, and no paid tiers or closed-source features.

name: Genie
description: CLI agent that interviews users, plans work, dispatches parallel agents in isolated worktrees, and reviews code before presenting results. 'Wishes in, PRs out' with integration support for Claude Code, Codex, Warp, and Hermes.

name: Code Buddy
description: Open-source multi-provider AI coding agent with terminal + Electron desktop interfaces. Features local-first execution on Ollama, 15 LLM providers with automatic failover, ~110 tools, and 24/7 multi-AI fleet capabilities.

name: Claude User Memory
description: Autonomous agent substrate for Claude Code CLI implementing Research→Plan→Implement workflows with quality gates, TDD enforcement, and multi-agent coordination. Built on Anthropic's engineering research with 4.8-5.5x faster development claims.

name: Koder
description: An experimental, open-source AI coding assistant for the terminal that combines a streaming TUI, persistent local sessions, durable goals and scheduled loops, repository-aware tools, extensible skills, MCP integrations, and sandbox-aware permissions in one Python runtime.

name: Terminator
description: A completely free opensource alternative to manus, openhands and cua. Multi-agent AI platform for code execution, research, and browser automation with standalone binary deployment.

name: Deadend CLI
description: Agentic pentest tooling achieving 81% on XBOW's benchmark in full black-box. Completely self-hosted with support for every model available on LiteLLM (Ollama, Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.). Autonomous web application penetration testing agent using feedback-driven iteration.

name: Hcom
description: CLI tool that enables AI coding agents to communicate, watch, and spawn each other across terminals. Single Rust binary with no background services. Supports Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, Kilo, Pi, Kimi, and Copilot CLI.

name: CC-Switch
description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build & Hermes Agent. Written in Rust using Tauri framework to provide unified interface for multiple AI coding CLI tools.

name: AI Instructions
description: CLI tool to scaffold AI development instructions for ClaudeCode, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and more. Provides complete instruction templates and 90 specialized agents for different development tasks.

name: Gemini CLI New
description: An open-source AI agent bringing Gemini's power directly to your terminal with native proxy API support. Features include querying and editing large codebases within Gemini's 1M token context window, multimodal capabilities, and MCP server integrations.

name: Kubiks CLI
description: Automatically instruments applications to capture comprehensive runtime data (logs, traces, requests, AI SDK calls) and integrates with AI code editors like Cursor through MCP to provide complete debugging context.

name: MCPDog
description: Universal MCP Server Manager that allows users to configure multiple MCP servers through a single interface. Features web dashboard, auto-detection, and unified proxy layer. Perfect for Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI & AI assistants.

name: Claude MPM (Multi-Agent Project Manager)
description: Workflow and agent management framework for Claude Code CLI with 47+ specialized agents, 56+ bundled skills, full MCP integration, session management, and GitHub-first SDK mode.

name: AI-Governor-Framework
description: A governance framework designed to teach AI assistants your project's unique DNA through a rules-based system and development workflow protocols. Turn any AI coding assistant into a disciplined, project-aware engineering partner that respects your architecture and coding standards.

name: Commentator
description: Local AI-powered CLI that writes Git commit messages using staged diffs. Works entirely offline using Code Llama via Ollama with no internet, telemetry, or GitHub Copilot required.

name: Agno CLI
description: Multi-modal AI agents living in your terminal with full modularity and customization. Features coordinated AI collaboration with role-based architecture (Leader, Worker, Contributor, Specialist, Coordinator, Observer) and comprehensive tool integration.

name: Minicoder
description: A minimalist AI terminal agent and assistant for Unix systems. Written in C with a tiny garbage collector, performs actions by generating shell scripts, tracks plans and todos across iterations, and manages file focus.
